replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. I feel calm when thinking about math because I tend to focus on its practical uses and visual representations. My low neuroticism and moderate conscientiousness mean I don't spiral into worry over complexity. If something feels hard, I step back, break it down, and use tools or logic to move forward without panic.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've used AI tools like chatbots to check solutions and explore new problem-solving methods.
